ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the center of the figure is a white diamond “◇”; on the left side of the diamond there is a black arrow, labeled 1, with the arrow direction from left to right pointing into the interior of the diamond; on the right side of the diamond there is a black arrow, labeled 2, with the arrow direction from the diamond pointing to the outside on the right. Then reason: the question stem states that “◇” represents the atmosphere, and that this is a partial schematic diagram of the water cycle. Arrow 1 represents the process by which water enters the atmosphere from outside the atmosphere. In the water cycle, water in the ocean enters the atmosphere mainly through evaporation, therefore arrow 1 represents seawater evaporation.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中中央是一个菱形“◇”，箭头1位于菱形左侧，箭头方向指向菱形内部；箭头2从菱形右侧指向外部。再读题干：题干规定“◇”表示大气圈，且整图是水循环的局部示意图。由此把箭头1理解为水分从菱形外的水体/海洋一侧进入大气圈的过程。根据水循环知识，海洋水分进入大气圈主要通过蒸发，因此箭头1表示海水蒸发。
